01 / START FAST

Routine templates

Templates create local editable drafts. They do not schedule an iPhone notification, read your accounts, or start a remote automation.

02 / MY SYSTEM

Saved routines

The schedule calculates when a routine is due when you open this app. iPhone Safari does not keep this page running in the background. For unattended time-based actions, configure a separate Apple Shortcuts Automation yourself.

03 / GUIDED EXECUTION

Run a routine

Website and Shortcuts buttons merely launch external actions on your tap. Marking a step means you personally confirmed it; it is not evidence from a bank, email provider, ChatGPT, or Windows HP relay.

04 / WORKFLOW EDITOR

Create a routine

Repeat on

Actions

Confirmation: a checklist item. Website: opens a HTTPS link you specify. Shortcut: opens an existing Apple Shortcut by its exact name; you must create it in the Shortcuts app and approve any permissions there. Launch does not automatically mark success.

    05 / AUDIT TRAIL

    My history

    History is local, owner-marked evidence only. It does not change the CF-200 registry or prove external results.

    06 / BACKUP & CONTROL

    Your data, your device

    Your routines and run history use private browser storage on this device. Safari can clear it; export a JSON backup to keep continuity. No cloud sync or other-account access is enabled.

    07 / IPHONE SETUP

    Put it on your Home Screen

    Install app icon

    Open this page in Safari on your iPhone. Tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen, then Add. The app can open offline after its first successful load.

    Connect a Shortcut

    In Apple's Shortcuts app, create and name a Shortcut. Add a Shortcut step here using the exact same name. Tap the launch button when ready. Background scheduling must be configured separately inside Shortcuts.

    Ready. Nothing runs without your action.
